literal.prompt: Какую страницу обычно помещают в начале книги справа; на ней указывают название, автора и издателя?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The manual describes the title page as usually right-hand near the front with title, author and publisher (L1056-1057); it distinguishes the title verso (L1058-1063), contents page (L1116-1124), and index (L1125-1129). This is part of a lesson teaching students to identify book parts (L999-1005).

literalGroups.literal: Титульный лист обычно находится справа в начале книги; на нём указывают название, автора и издателя. На обороте титульного листа традиционно приводят дополнительные сведения об издателе и книге, включая copyright.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Peace Corps states that the title page is usually on the right near the front and carries title, author, publisher (L1056-L1057). It then describes the title verso page as traditionally the left-hand page immediately after the title page and says that this title-verso area contains further publisher/book data and copyright (L1058-L1063). The Russian wording “на обороте титульного листа” expresses the verso relation and does not claim a facing page in the same spread.

literalGroups.literal: На обороте титульного листа традиционно приводят дополнительные сведения об издателе и книге, включая copyright.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Additional own-option fact: the reverse/title-verso side traditionally carries publisher/book details and copyright (L1058-L1063); this is distinct from the title/author/publisher facts in the prompt and key.

literalGroups.literal: Титульный оборот традиционно содержит дополнительные сведения об издателе и книге, например адрес издателя, год выпуска, типографию и copyright.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The manual describes the title verso page as traditionally following the title page and carrying additional publisher information/address, publication year/reprint/printer details, and copyright (L1058-L1063). The wording does not turn “after” into “facing left”.

literalGroups.literal: Она даёт план или краткое описание глав и указывает страницы, на которых они начинаются.
literalGroups.primaryGround: A contents page outlines or summarizes chapters and supplies page numbers so readers can turn to them (L1116-1124).

literalGroups.literal: Он обычно находится в конце книги и перечисляет по алфавиту темы, имена и другие важные понятия с номерами страниц.
literalGroups.primaryGround: An index is usually at the back, lists subjects, people and other important items alphabetically, and gives page references (L1125-1129).

entries.absoluteDifficulty: EASY: recognizing a title page and its usual title/author/publisher fields is broad adult book familiarity, not specialist publishing knowledge. The primary source uses “usually”; the proposal preserves the qualifier.

sourceLimitations: Peace Corps source is an educational manual teaching pupils about book parts, not a universal legal or publishing standard; wording retains “usually” and “traditionally.”
